title: SALMONN: Towards Generic Hearing Abilities for Large Language Models
layout_note: Audio icons at bottom-left fork into two stacked encoders whose outputs merge into one row of frame columns; that row and a text-instruction branch on the right rise side by side into one wide LLM bar with a LoRA box on its right end.
grouping: No containers around modules; a framed legend box in the top-left corner keys token colours and the frozen/trainable icons. Feature columns are grouped into windows by small brackets above them; the LLM bar spans both the auditory and the textual embedding rows.
shapes_depth: Flat rectangles with thin black outlines: modules as wide boxes (light grey = frozen, salmon = trainable), tokens as narrow rounded cells in rows (yellow queries, light-blue Whisper stacked on green BEATs per frame, dark-grey auditory, beige textual embeddings). Thick black block arrows for the main upward flow, thin arrows elsewhere; snowflake and flame icons in the boxes; clip-art icons for inputs.
proposed_highlight: The trainable parts (Window-level Q-Former and LoRA) are filled salmon and carry a flame icon, against light-grey frozen encoders and LLM marked with snowflakes; the legend keys the icons.
lesson: Stack the two encoders' feature cells frame-aligned, one colour per encoder, and bracket them into windows, so window-level fusion is visible as geometry before any label is read.
notes: Venue and year from the first page ('Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2024'). flow 'mixed': left to right from the audio icons through the encoders to the feature row, then bottom to top into the LLM. The input icons are embedded images (photo_share).

arrangement.units: one composition without frames: encoders and Q-Former on the left, the feature row in the middle, LLM bar with attached LoRA box across the top, a legend box in the top-left corner
arrangement.inputs_as: clip-art icons (music notes, equalizer bars, a speaking person) at bottom-left for audio; a person-with-lightbulb icon under 'Text instruction prompt' at bottom-right
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; the output is the label 'Text response' above the LLM
arrangement.shared: the LLM is one bar spanning both the auditory and the textual embedding rows

taxonomy.task: generic hearing (speech, audio events, music) by an LLM through a window-level Q-Former bridge and LoRA

insights.structure: Two encoder boxes stacked at left feed one row of feature columns in the middle; that row and the text prompt rise into one LLM bar along the top, with LoRA attached as a separate box at the bar's right end.
insights.data: Every representation is a row of narrow rounded cells in its own keyed colour: queries, Whisper and BEATs features (stacked per frame), auditory and textual embeddings.
insights.emphasis: Salmon fill plus a flame icon marks the trained parts (Q-Former, LoRA); frozen modules are light grey with a snowflake.
insights.flow: Thin arrows fork from the audio icons into both encoders; thick black block arrows carry the main flow upward into the LLM and on to 'Text response'.
insights.avoid: The Q-Former sits at the far left and its per-window use is drawn as a long dashed line running right across the window arrows to the text prompt, which reads as if it fed the prompt.

core.what: Whisper and BEATs encoders fork from one audio input and converge into a single row of frame columns, each a blue Whisper cell stacked on a green BEATs cell, bracketed into windows that rise as grey auditory tokens

relations.form: two stacked encoder boxes send block arrows into one row where each frame column stacks a light-blue cell on a green cell, windows marked by brackets above
the auditory-embedding row and the textual-embedding row rise side by side into one LLM bar that spans both
bottom to top on thick block arrows: feature row, auditory embeddings, LLM, 'Text response'
the Window-level Q-Former is one box at the left whose use on every window is a dashed horizontal line crossing the windows' upward arrows

channels.colour: token cells: kind of representation (yellow queries, light-blue Whisper, green BEATs, dark-grey auditory, beige textual), keyed in the legend; module fill: light grey = frozen, salmon = trainable, the same meaning also carried by snowflake/flame icons; the light-grey module fill sits close to the dark-grey auditory tokens
channels.shape: wide rectangles = modules, narrow rounded cells = tokens/embeddings, clip-art icons = raw inputs and the instructing user
channels.line: thick black block arrows = main data flow, thin arrows = fork into encoders and window outputs, dashed line = the Q-Former applied across windows
channels.frame: only the legend box is framed

quality.strengths: Every compared or passed representation is drawn as a row of keyed cells between its maker and the LLM; frame-aligned stacking of the two encoders' features makes the fusion visible as geometry; frozen vs trainable is keyed and consistent; block arrows run straight upward.
quality.weaknesses: The Q-Former, the contribution, sits far from the windows it processes and is joined to them by a long dashed line that ends at the text prompt label; the salmon 'trainable' fill is not itself in the legend (only the flame icon is); the legend takes most of the top-left quarter.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
